title: 003 镇邪004 诅咒
content_zh:
留下小晴守在厨房后。
许临东顶着唯有超凡者才能感知到的热气屏障，走出了厨房。
只要厨房内的灶灯不灭，超凡力量不耗尽，他身上的热气屏障就不会消失。
但还未走近房间，藤木椅上的老头便仿佛察觉到了危险在靠近，竟是骤然嘶吼，竟硬生生挣断绑绳，扑向一旁的治安官。
几名治安官急退，迅速架起备好的防暴盾与防暴叉。
能成为治安官的，精气神皆远超常人两倍以上，个个百米十秒内轻松跑完，力量更是惊人。
可此刻三人联手，竟也只勉强将老头抵到墙角。
“砰砰”
闷响中，盾牌几乎被那发狂的身影撞开。
“这么大力气？”
梁启正与李云帆同时一惊。
这次的邪异物感染者显然不同以往。
许临东见状皱眉，周身环绕的热气屏障却让他底气涌起。
他当即迅速大步上前，低喝道，“云帆，你去准备贡品，待会儿喂给这周老头吃。”
“哦，好的东哥！”
李云帆立即点头，神色严峻。
他同样也是天道序列十的灶官。
只不过目前他只掌握了最基础的“灶灰”
与“贡品”
的制作能力，勉强能吹一口‘灶烟’，还没掌握‘灶火’。

超凡实力比许临东差上不少，只能打打辅助。
许临东说完，已是迅速进了房间。
几个治安官见他进来，都是心中一定。
“让开一条道！”
许临东一声低喝。
顿时手持防暴盾牌的治安官会意，迅速后撤一步。
许临东一个蹿步上前，手中已经有些发黑的烟蒂烟灰攥入掌心，瞬间出手。
“镇！
！”
就在发狂的周老头即将钻出防暴盾牌露出的空隙的刹那。
许临东的手已先一步抵在对方额头，那道狰狞散发恶臭的伤口上。
“嘭！”
烟灰震散一圈。
掌心超凡之力爆发，在老头额头烙下一圈灰印。
“好大的力气！”
他的手臂一震，皱眉看着面目狰狞发青，甚至都显露了一些獠牙的老头。
“这种尸变程度，很不正常啊，这老头撞上的地道序列邪异物，难道是序列九【游魂】层次的？”
他心中已是有些不惊反喜。
若能拿下这邪异物，他的通天塔正好用得上，绝对能多得许多的功德。
此时，被烟灰一掌击中的老头，却诡异地僵在原地，一动不动。

几个治安官都是惊疑不定起来。
但眼见老头已是停下了疯狂举动，不由都松口气。
许临东缓缓收手，能清晰感到老头身上那股阴冷尸气，正不断侵蚀着他的手掌。
但那尸气刚一迫近，便被他周身笼罩的一层普通人无法看见的热气屏障隔绝在外。
content_en:
Xiao Qing was left behind the kitchen.
Xu Lindong walked out of the kitchen against the heat barrier that only extraordinary people could sense.
As long as the stove light in the kitchen does not go out and the extraordinary power is not exhausted, the heat barrier on his body will not disappear.
But before he even got close to the room, the old man on the rattan chair seemed to sense the danger approaching. He roared suddenly, broke the rope, and threw himself at the sheriff beside him.
Several police officers retreated and quickly set up prepared riot shields and anti-riot forks.
Those who can become peace officers have more than twice the energy and energy of ordinary people. They can easily run 100 meters in ten seconds, and their strength is even more amazing.
But now the three of them joined forces and could only barely push the old man into the corner.
"Bang bang"
In the muffled sound, the shield was almost knocked away by the crazy figure.
"So much effort?"
Liang Qizheng and Li Yunfan were shocked at the same time.
The people infected with evil foreign objects this time are obviously different from the past.
Xu Lindong frowned when he saw this, but the heat barrier surrounding him made him feel confident.
He immediately strode forward quickly and shouted, "Yunfan, go prepare the tribute and feed it to old man Zhou Zhou later."
"Oh, okay Brother Dong!"
Li Yunfan nodded immediately with a serious expression.
He is also the Zao Guan of Tiandao Sequence Ten.
It's just that he has only mastered the most basic "Zo Hui" at present.
and "tribute"
My production ability is barely enough to blow a puff of 'stove smoke', but I haven't mastered 'stove fire' yet.
His extraordinary strength is much inferior to that of Xu Lindong, so he can only play as a support player.
After Xu Lindong finished speaking, he quickly entered the room.
When several police officers saw him coming in, they all felt certain.
"Get out of the way!"
Xu Lindong shouted lowly.
The police officer holding the riot shield suddenly understood and quickly took a step back.
Xu Lindong stepped forward, holding the already blackened cigarette butt and ashes in his palm, and took action instantly.
“Town!
! "
Just when the frantic old man Zhou was about to get out of the gap exposed by the riot shield.
Xu Lindong's hand was already on the other person's forehead, the hideous and stinking wound.
"Bang!"
The ashes dispersed in a circle.
The extraordinary power exploded from the palm of his hand, leaving a gray mark on the old man's forehead.
"What a strength!"
His arm trembled, and he frowned at the old man, whose face was ferocious and green, even showing some fangs.
"This level of corpse transformation is very abnormal. Is the authentic Sequence Evil Foreign Object that this old man bumped into a Sequence Nine [Wandering Soul] level?"
He was already a little surprised instead of happy.
If he could capture this evil foreign object, his Tower of Babel would be put to good use, and he would definitely gain a lot more merit.
At this time, the old man who was hit by Soot's palm was strangely frozen in place, motionless.
Several police officers were shocked and confused.
But seeing that the old man had stopped his crazy behavior, they couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Xu Lindong slowly closed his hand, and he could clearly feel the cold corpse energy on the old man's body, which was constantly eroding his palm.
But as soon as the corpse energy approached, he was isolated by a heat barrier that enveloped him and was invisible to ordinary people.
